meta.what: Wind correction for the modelled weather years, six-constant (calm-preserving) version, on by default (FIXED.wxWindCorr 1; user decision, 4 Nov 2026, message 693 (a): for the twelve-year means, the tail, the stress windows and the engine): corrected national per-unit wind output by calendar month (rows, January first) on a grid of stored per-unit output 0-1 (columns).
meta.method: Stored output p (Renewables.ninja MERRA-2, Vestas V90 2000 at 80 m, with the 1.0753 level factor) inverted to an effective hub speed on windpowerlib's V90/2000 power curve after dividing by 1.0753; plus d(m) = beta + A cos(2 pi (m - phi) / 12) m/s (m = 0 for January), faded in linearly between v0 3.0 m/s (the curve's last zero point) and v_c 4.0 m/s, so the lowest winds are left as stored; speeds above v_k compressed by alpha; back through the curve. Six constants, fitted on the clock-fixed modelled series against Eskom's metered wind (ESK19679, Wind over Wind Installed Capacity, April 2022 to December 2025; 29 February 2024 and 31 December 2024 left out).
meta.limits: Level about 3% uncertain from year to year. Out of sample (leave one year out) hours below 5% of capacity 69 a year against metered 78 (five-constant 48, stored 121); the long metered calms (31-36 h below 10%) are not reproduced by any correction of output. RESULTS, 3-4 Nov 2026 (686 (b), 691 (b)).
meta.source: Eskom data ESK19679 (obtained on request, Eskom Holdings SOC Ltd); the analysis and the constants are GridTwin ZA's, not Eskom's. Only these constants and this table derived from them are published; no Eskom hourly series is.
meta.built_by: scratch refit scripts of 3 Nov 2026 (windcorr/esk/r1_refit.py); table 12 x 2,001, linear interpolation between points
